title: UnitedHealth Group tops estimates, hikes profit outlook as insurer manages high medical costs
summary_full: UnitedHealth Group said it expects 2026 adjusted earnings of at least $20.50 per share, up from a previous outlook of $19.50 to $20.00 per share.
